lines.cap: Which papers actually support your research gap?

lines.say: Reading them all takes time, and you still end up with citations you can't trace.
lines.cap: Reading them all takes time, | and you still end up with citations you can't trace.

lines.say: This is Cite Wise: an AI-powered research assistant that takes you from research gap to drafted introduction, in one connected flow.
lines.cap: This is CiteWise: an AI-powered research assistant | that takes you from research gap to drafted introduction, | in one connected flow.

lines.say: Step one: Data Import.
lines.cap: Step one: Data Import.

lines.say: One click brings in your research title, rationale, and gaps from your Catalyst workspace.
lines.cap: One click brings in your research title, rationale, and gaps | from your CATalyst workspace.

lines.say: Then you upload your related literature as PDFs.
lines.cap: Then you upload your related literature as PDFs.

lines.say: Step two: AI Assessment.
lines.cap: Step two: AI Assessment.

lines.say: Each paper is scored against your research gap on four weighted criteria: gap alignment, methodology, theory, and citation quality.
lines.cap: Each paper is scored against your research gap | on four weighted criteria: | gap alignment, methodology, theory, and citation quality.

lines.say: Every score comes with word-for-word evidence, verified to the exact page, so you can check it yourself.
lines.cap: Every score comes with word-for-word evidence, | verified to the exact page, so you can check it yourself.

lines.say: You stay in control: approve what fits, leave out what doesn't.
lines.cap: You stay in control: approve what fits, leave out what doesn't.

lines.say: Step three: Generate Introduction.
lines.cap: Step three: Generate Introduction.

lines.say: Cite Wise drafts your introduction from only the sources you approved, with in-text citations and a reference list.
lines.cap: CiteWise drafts your introduction from only the sources you approved, | with in-text citations and a reference list.

lines.say: Paraphrase it, keep a version history, and export to PDF or Word.
lines.cap: Paraphrase it, keep a version history, and export to PDF or Word.

lines.say: On real research papers, text extraction finished in under half a second, and a full AI assessment averaged about twenty-four seconds, against a thirty-second target.
lines.cap: On real research papers, text extraction finished in under half a second, | and a full AI assessment averaged about 24 seconds, | against a 30-second target.

lines.say: Change the weights, and scores update with no extra AI call.
lines.cap: Change the weights, and scores update with no extra AI call.
